title: Phase 5 tasks unchecked but the spec-sync work IS done (DONE_BUT_UNCHECKED plan gap)
description: Plan tasks 5.1–5.6 are all still marked `- [ ]` and the Execution Log (line 674) records Phase 5 as 'Not started'. However `git diff main...HEAD` shows all four target feature specs were reconciled (feature-decision-making.md, feature-decision-records.md, feature-external-researcher.md, feature-document-templates.md all changed, plus related_changes/GH-133 wired in, NFRs added, last_updated bumped). The user confirms the change is doc-synced. This is stale plan bookkeeping, not a missing deliverable.
suggestedFix: Check tasks 5.1–5.6 in the plan, update the Phase 5 Execution Log row to Completed with the doc-syncer's commit SHA, and (if a separate spec-sync commit exists) note it. AC-11 is otherwise unverifiable from the plan state alone.

title: R1 worked example omits References while References is tagged R1/R2/R3
description: The template's 'References' section is annotated `<!-- rigor: R1/R2/R3 -->` and the R1 comment-block enumerates the R1 section set. The worked R1 example appendix renders Context, Problem Framing, Constraints, Decision Drivers, Mental Models, Alternatives, Decision, Owner, Revisit trigger — but omits References. The example is therefore slightly narrower than the stated R1 set (subset-of-subset), which a reviewer or agent could misread as 'References is R3-only'.
suggestedFix: Either add a one-line `References:` entry to the R1 worked example (a single related link) or add a parenthetical noting the example is intentionally minimal and References remains R1-allowed. Keeps the example self-consistent with TC-TPL-008.

title: Agent inventory summaries not refreshed despite materially new agent behavior
description: The test-plan §1.1 lists `.opencode/README.md (if agent behavior summary changes)` as in-scope, and both edited agents gained substantive new behavior: `@decision-advisor` now delegates bounded evidence gathering and applies R1-default-local + license-as-human-step; `@external-researcher` now exposes a Decision-evidence gathering mode. The README summaries ('decisions of all types ... decision record authoring' / 'research external sources via MCP') remain technically accurate at the high level but no longer surface the new capabilities. Non-blocking; the AGENTS.md inventory already covers it.
suggestedFix: Optionally append a short clause to each summary (e.g., decision-advisor: '...; delegates bounded selection-evidence to @external-researcher'). Skip if the inventory deliberately stays at the one-line level.

title: Three divergent AC numbering schemes across artifacts (reconciled, but a maintenance smell)
description: The spec uses AC-F#-#, the test-plan uses AC-01..AC-23, and the plan uses AC-1..AC-11 (grouped). The plan's Cross-Artifact AC Traceability Matrix reconciles them, so this is not a defect — but it forces every reviewer to consult the matrix to confirm coverage of any given AC. Acceptable given the artifacts were authored in parallel.
suggestedFix: No action required for this change. Consider standardizing one AC-notation in the template for future multi-artifact changes.
